description: Inline row of 3-5 hero stats with bold numeric values. Drops in below a hero to anchor credibility with concrete numbers. Skip if no real metrics are available — fake stats are worse than no stats.

stats.type: array<{ value: string, label: string, accent?: string }>
stats.hint: 3-5 items. value is the headline number (e.g. '4.9', '120k'). accent is an optional suffix that renders in primary color (e.g. '+', 'x'). label is short — 2-5 words. Avoid percentages that round suspiciously.

bordered.hint: Bottom border separator. Set false when the strip is the first element on a page (no sibling above).
